what_this_is: The Workshop rows for a person's notification choices and the notices recorded for them, in tools/notifications, kept in their own records through the run's records door.

payload.label: How I chose to be notified
payload.job: Show the options a notification setting offers this person and which one they chose
payload.description: setting is the name of a setting the person described in their own records. Returns { setting, heading, explanation, options: [{ id, label, description, current }], current, status, said }. status is ready, empty (the setting describes no options), missing (the person has described no such setting; said tells how) or invalid (the saved choice is not one of the options; it is reported, not corrected). It changes nothing.

provenance.source: bitfield-packages notifications read-data/read-notifications-policy.ts (option list, current value, empty and invalid status), ported to the records door without its modes or its action route

payload.label: Choose how I am notified
payload.job: Keep one of a notification setting's options as this person's choice
payload.description: setting is the setting's name and choice one option id from tool:my-notification-choice. A choice that is not one of the options is refused with the options named. A setting that is not described, or describes no options, has nothing to choose from: it returns changed false and says so in said, and keeps nothing. Returns { setting, choice, previous, changed, said }; choosing what is already chosen changes nothing.

provenance.source: bitfield-packages notifications do-work/save-setting.ts (insert the chosen option id), ported to a records-door write of the choice after checking it is a described option

payload.label: Record a notice for someone
payload.job: Record one notification event for the audience the caller names, so it is kept and can be read back; nothing is delivered
payload.description: Pass the event: notification_id, kind, conversation_ref, privacy_class, title, body, occurred_at (words) and audience_refs, source_refs, proof_refs (each at least one reference). Optional actions are preserved in the told notice as its offered action definitions, including post:{path,body}, open:{surface_id,...} and press. operationId, transitionId and idempotencyKey are optional. No audience is inferred and no field has a default. If the person saved a notification-event-rules record (kinds, privacy_classes), kind and privacy_class must be among those it lists; with none, any words are accepted. The same event again changes nothing; a different event under the same notification_id is refused. Returns { notification_id, recorded, said }.

provenance.source: bitfield-packages notifications things-to-store-and-run.json action record-notification-event (its input schema and the record it wrote), ported to the records door

payload.label: Notices recorded for me
payload.job: List the notification events recorded for one audience, newest first
payload.description: audience is the reference the events name in audience_refs; limit is optional (up to 100, default 20). Returns { audience, events, said }, each event exactly as it was recorded. It changes nothing.

provenance.source: bitfield-packages notifications notification-events feed, read back by audience through the records door

payload.label: My notification devices
payload.job: List the devices registered to show or read my notices
payload.description: Returns each registered device by opaque device_id, route, label and status. Push tokens and addresses are never returned.

provenance.source: Native device notice and APNs owners, implemented through the Workshop records door and held credential pipe

payload.label: Register my notification device
payload.job: Register this device to receive or read my notices
payload.description: Pass route (web-push, apns, apns-activity or live) and the address its app received. For web-push, address is {endpoint,keys:{p256dh,auth}}; APNs routes use a hex token. Apple routes also need app (the bundle id); apns-activity also requires attributes_type, the receiving app’s exact Swift ActivityAttributes type and may set environment (sandbox or production). Optional label, can_show, turn_on and present describe this device. The stable device_id is returned; its private address is kept in your records and never returned. Repeating the same registration keeps its id. At most 40 devices are kept.

attributes_type.description: Required for apns-activity: the exact native Swift ActivityAttributes type, optionally module-qualified.

provenance.source: Native device notice and APNs owners, implemented through the Workshop records door and held credential pipe

payload.label: Remove my notification device
payload.job: Stop sending or queueing notices for one of my devices
payload.description: Pass the opaque device_id from my-notification-devices. The private address is removed from this person’s records. A device that later registers again receives its own id.

provenance.source: Native device notice and APNs owners, implemented through the Workshop records door and held credential pipe

payload.label: Register or end my Live Activity
payload.job: Keep this iPhone Live Activity token so this account can update or end it
payload.description: Pass board_key, the activity push token, app bundle id and environment. ended=true removes the token when the activity ends. Tokens stay private in your own records; the answer never returns them.

provenance.source: Native device notice and APNs owners, implemented through the Workshop records door and held credential pipe

payload.label: Send a recorded notification to my devices
payload.job: Send one already-recorded notice through my registered Apple devices
payload.description: Pass notification_id and the audience reference that the recorded event names. The notice is first kept in told-the-person; APNs and browser push attempts are recorded before sending, accepted is never treated as read, and an unknown network result is not blindly retried. Set retry_failed only after a definite failure. Device-pull registrations get the notice queued for their next read; per-device route results identify which registered devices received or may read it.

provenance.source: Native device notice and APNs owners, implemented through the Workshop records door and held credential pipe

payload.label: Update my Live Activity
payload.job: Start, update or end the one Live Activity board for running work
payload.description: Pass a stable update_id, board_key and up to four items. Push-to-start uses each device’s registered attributes_type; missing or invalid registration refuses delivery without guessing a native type. Running items update existing activity tokens or push-to-start when none has returned yet; an empty running set ends active tokens. Apple acceptance does not prove the person saw it. Reusing update_id returns its durable result; unknown outcomes are never sent again. Definite failures may be retried with retry_failed=true.

provenance.source: Native device notice and APNs owners, implemented through the Workshop records door and held credential pipe

payload.label: My browser push application key
payload.job: Get the public key browsers need to register for notices
payload.description: Returns only the base64url P-256 public applicationServerKey derived from the web_push field of the held notification-signing-keys bundle. The private signing scalar and contact stay on the credential pipe.

provenance.source: The public Web Push application key derived from the held credential used by tools/notifications/read-data/web-push.mjs
